chain.title: Demon's Dream Seeds
chain.desc: Dropped when breaking grass; plant them to grow the Demon's Dream herb, the first step into the Otherworld.

chain.title: Demon's Dream Fruit
chain.desc: Harvested from the grown crop; eating it has a chance to grant the Third Eye effect that reveals Otherworld materials.

chain.title: Spiritfire
chain.desc: Throw a Demon's Dream Fruit on the ground and light it with flint and steel; items tossed into the purple flame are converted without the fire going out.

chain.title: Otherstone
chain.desc: Made by throwing andesite into Spiritfire; the base stone for sacrificial bowls, pedestals and other ritual furniture.

chain.title: Divination Rod
chain.desc: Crafted from a wooden rod and a Spirit Attuned Gem (a diamond converted in Spiritfire); attune it to a sample block to locate hidden Otherworld trees and ores.

chain.title: Otherworld Wood
chain.desc: Chopped from Otherworld trees, grown from a sapling obtained by burning an oak sapling in Spiritfire or found by divination; burning the log in Spiritfire yields Otherworld Ashes for chalk.

chain.title: White Chalk
chain.desc: Craft impure white chalk from Burnt Otherstone and Otherworld Ashes, then purify it in Spiritfire; draws the basic Foliot-tier pentacles.

chain.title: Sacrificial Bowl
chain.desc: Crafted from Otherstone; bowls around the pentacle hold ritual ingredients while a Golden Sacrificial Bowl at the center receives the activation item.

chain.title: Bound Book of Binding: Foliot
chain.desc: Craft a Book of Binding from a Taboo Book, Purified Ink and an Awakened Feather (all Spiritfire conversions) plus white dye, then inscribe a Foliot's true name from the Dictionary of Spirits.

chain.title: First Ritual: the Crusher
chain.desc: Summon a Foliot Crusher on Aviar's Circle using raw iron, gold, copper and silver; the spirit crushes raw ores into doubled dusts like this one.

chain.title: Golden Chalk
chain.desc: Combine impure white chalk with gold dust and glowstone dust, then purify in Spiritfire; required for Djinni-tier pentacles.

chain.title: Bound Book of Binding: Djinni
chain.desc: A Djinni-grade Book of Binding inscribed with a Djinni's true name; the activation item for all Djinni summoning and crafting rituals.

chain.title: Otherworld Goggles
chain.desc: Infused Lenses from a Djinni crafting ritual, framed with leather and a silver-and-otherstone Lens Frame; grants permanent Third Eye while worn.

chain.title: Infused Pickaxe
chain.desc: Djinni crafting ritual over a Spirit Attuned Pickaxe Head with silver ingots and wooden rods; one of the only tools that can break Iesnium ore.

chain.title: Iesnium
chain.desc: Mine Iesnium ore in the Nether, visible only with the Third Eye or goggles and breakable only by infused tools, then smelt or blast it into ingots.

chain.title: Iesnium Pickaxe
chain.desc: Crafted normally from three Iesnium ingots and sticks; a durable spirit pickaxe consumed as an ingredient by every miner-spirit ritual.

chain.title: Dimensional Storage Actuator
chain.desc: Combine a Storage Controller Base (Foliot craft ritual on an Otherstone Pedestal with gold) with a Dimensional Matrix (Djinni craft ritual on quartz blocks and an ender pearl) for spirit-run mass storage.

chain.title: Dimensional Mineshaft
chain.desc: Djinni crafting ritual using Otherstone, gold, a Spirit Attuned Crystal and an Iesnium block; a spirit-only portal block that lets lamp-bound miners work for you.

chain.title: Foliot Miner
chain.desc: Foliot crafting ritual that binds a miner spirit into an empty Magic Lamp (silver and Iesnium) alongside an Iesnium Pickaxe, raw iron and gravel; produces assorted blocks in the mineshaft.

chain.title: Purple Chalk
chain.desc: Combine impure white chalk with crushed end stone and obsidian dust, then purify in Spiritfire; draws Afrit-tier pentacles.

chain.title: Slay an Unbound Afrit
chain.desc: Summon an uncontrolled Afrit with a bound Afrit book on the purple-chalk Abras' Conjure pentacle, then kill it to claim its Afrit Essence.

chain.title: Red Chalk
chain.desc: Combine impure white chalk with Afrit Essence and blaze powder, then purify in Spiritfire; the final chalk tier, needed for Marid rituals.

chain.title: Djinni Ore Miner
chain.desc: Djinni crafting ritual upgrading the Foliot Miner with an Iesnium Pickaxe, raw gold, a lapis block and a Spirit Attuned Crystal; mines only ores, including Iesnium.

chain.title: Marid Master Miner
chain.desc: Red-chalk Marid crafting ritual that upgrades the Afrit Deep-Ore Miner with a netherite pickaxe, dragon's breath, a totem of undying and a nether star; the endgame miner spirit.

notes: All 23 item ids and the kill entity verified against occultism-1.20.1-1.158.0.jar (112 items = models/item stems intersected with item./block.occultism lang keys; entity.occultism.afrit_wild confirmed in en_us.json). No ids dropped. Facts sourced from the in-jar modonomicon book (data/occultism/modonomicon/books/dictionary_of_spirits, getting_started category) and data/occultism/recipes (spirit_fire, crafting, ritual). No dim: entries: this version registers no dimension - the 'mining dimension' is the dimensional_mineshaft block, not a real dimension. Intermediate afrit-tier miner (miner_afrit_deeps: Djinni miner + echo shard + crying obsidian + afrit essence) omitted to stay within milestone budget; mentioned via the Marid entry. Side content intentionally omitted: familiars (14 rituals + familiar_ring/soul_gem), possession rituals (possessed skeleton/enderman/ghast etc.), storage stabilizers tiers 1-4, wormholes/storage_remote, satchel, lumberjack/transporter/janitor helper spirits, Wild Hunt (wither skull farm), demonic partners, time/weather magic.
